news.title: AI Stocks Rally & Fed Rate Bets Hit Bonds – Asia Market Wrap
news.description: Global stocks advanced as renewed enthusiasm for AI outweighed concerns that hotter-than-expected US inflation could prompt further Fed rate hikes. Nasdaq 100 futures rose 1.5%, recovering Tuesday’s regulatory-driven losses, while S&P 500 futures gained 0.6%. European equity futures also pointed higher, and the MSCI Asia Pacific Index climbed 1.6% following its strongest two-day performance in more than three months, with tech leading gains. The AI trade gained support from an upbeat outlook
